answer: Trust the record, not the story. Enrolled air traffic controller licence with air navigation attestation is the record: a licence navigation officers renew after shift audits. The crystal is the bookkeeping — entries written by other hands, for other reasons, in books the applicant cannot open. A story can be told in an evening; a book takes years to fill, and the saffron is the ink in it: every fee, every visit, every examination, dated and signed. The beacon is the second book, kept elsewhere, telling the same dates.
